title: Business password reset
content: Select Forgot password on the fictional business banking login page. Complete verification using your registered device, then choose a new password.

title: Block a lost card
content: Open Cards in the fictional app and choose Block card immediately. Contact fictional support if you cannot sign in.

title: Transfer transaction limits
content: The fictional standard transfer limit is 10000 demo units per day. An account administrator can request a limit review in Settings.

title: Business account access
content: An existing administrator can invite a colleague from Business access. Assign the least privileged role and require device verification.

title: Suspicious transactions
content: Open the transaction and select Report suspicious activity. Block affected cards and contact fictional support. Never share verification codes.

title: International transfers
content: For an international transfer, enter the recipient IBAN and BIC, check the currency and displayed fee, and review before confirming. Delivery can take 1 to 3 business days.

title: Support opening hours
content: Fictional general support is open Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00. Card blocking is available in the app at all times.

title: Customer identity verification
content: Complete customer identity verification only inside the fictional secure app. Use the document upload flow; never send identity documents in chat.

title: Download account statements
content: Open Accounts, choose Statements, select a date range, and download a PDF. Business administrators control statement access.

title: View card PIN
content: Open Cards and choose View PIN after device verification. Never disclose your PIN to support or in chat.

title: Change business address
content: An administrator can request a business address change under Business profile. Supporting documents may be requested through the secure upload flow.

title: Cancel scheduled payments
content: Open Scheduled payments, select the payment, and choose Cancel before its execution date. Completed payments cannot be cancelled in this flow.

title: Order replacement card
content: After blocking the old card, choose Order replacement under Cards. Fictional delivery normally takes 5 business days.

title: Account service fees
content: The fictional standard account service fee is 5 demo units monthly. Review the current fictional fee schedule in Documents before accepting a service.

title: Register new device
content: On the login screen select Register new device. Verify using your existing device or use the secure recovery flow if it is unavailable.

title: Close business account
content: An administrator can request account closure through secure support after settling pending payments and downloading statements.

title: Track transfer status
content: Open Transfers and select the transfer to view its status. Pending means processing has not completed. Contact fictional support if the expected delivery window has passed.

title: Payment notification settings
content: Open Settings and then Notifications to enable payment alerts. Delivery depends on your device notification permissions.
